title: To Compare, or Not to Compare: On Methodological Practices in Evaluating Social Bias
reasoning: The paper identifies religion as one of its three core demographic axes for evaluating social bias. It uses multiple benchmarks (StereoSet, RedditBias, BBQ, DiscrimEvalGen, and DecodingTrust-Toxicity) to analyze stereotypes and discrimination targeting religious groups, specifically focusing on Muslim and Christian identities.
